title: Optimizing Sparse Boolean Rule Networks using Mixed Integer Linear Programming
abstract: arXiv:2610.20170v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the problem of learning accurate and cognitively simple binary classifiers that are directly interpretable as Boolean rules. We propose mixed integer linear programming (MILP) formulations for training sparse disjunctive normal form (DNF) networks, viewed as small networks with a conjunctive hidden layer and a disjunctive output layer. Contrary to previous work that uses MILP for inductive rule learning, we start with a fixed network structure, for which we then find optimal weights. A regularized objective explicitly trades off misclassification costs against sparsity, yielding globally optimized rule sets. Our main technical contribution is an enhanced formulation that substantially reduces the number of integer decision variables and eliminates redundant constraints, while preserving exact Boolean semantics for all feasible solutions. translated_title: 使用混合整数线性规划优化稀疏布尔规则网络
translated_abstract: 我们研究学习准确且认知上简单的二分类器的问题，这类分类器可以直接解释为布尔规则。我们提出了用于训练稀疏析取范式（DNF）网络的混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式，这类网络可被视为由合取隐藏层和析取输出层组成的小型网络。与以往使用MILP进行归纳规则学习的工作不同，我们从固定的网络结构出发，进而为其寻找最优权重。正则化的目标函数明确地在误分类成本与稀疏性之间进行权衡，从而产生全局优化的规则集。我们的主要技术贡献是一种增强的公式，它大幅减少了整数决策变量的数量并消除了冗余约束，同时对所有可行解保持精确的布尔语义。此外，我们开发了一种基于初始化和dropout相结合的方法来打破对称性……
tldr: 该论文提出用混合整数线性规划训练稀疏的布尔规则网络（DNF网络），通过增强的公式大幅减少整数决策变量并消除冗余约束，在保持精确布尔语义的同时实现误分类成本与稀疏性之间的全局最优权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MILP formulations for training sparse Boolean rule (DNF) networks, featuring an enhanced formulation that substantially reduces integer decision variables and eliminates redundant constraints while preserving exact Boolean semantics, yielding globally optimized trade-offs between misclassification cost and sparsity.
